Arden’s Master of Public Health course has been developed to meet the increasing demand for graduates with a passion for managing and leading preventive health services in communicable and non-communicable diseases. The course places emphasis on providing students with the most current skills in healthcare and digital literacy in health services management, giving them the ability to support healthcare delivery and better health outcomes at population, community, and national level.

The course is designed to be flexible and contemporary in its structure and delivery, and has been developed in close collaboration with leading public health employers and industry advisory groups. This means students will be exposed to a variety of teaching approaches and assessment methods to support the development of knowledge and abilities in public health, helping students graduate with the specialised skills necessary for a successful career in the public health sector.

This public health master course also prepares students for the digital and data driven world that the public health profession has now moved into. Students will also have the opportunity to become proficient with a wealth of digital technologies such as SPSS, NVIVO, Stata, Gorilla, and more. This gives students the chance to learn about virtual simulations used to predict, model, and plan for future infectious and non-infectious disease outbreaks, as well as how to respond to real life challenges that may arise in a student's future career in public health.
8vis:
Arden University's MSc Cyber Security programme is aligned with the NCSC academic framework and equips students with the skills necessary to thrive in highly lucrative cyber security roles. In recent studies, 57% of businesses said they currently have unfilled cyber security positions* , and 1.8 million jobs in the field went unfilled in 2022 alone**. With such huge skills gaps and a burgeoning demand for cyber experts across the globe, this course will arm students with the knowledge they need to excel as an expert in cyber security across almost limitless industries.

Arden's programme goes deep into cyber security, covering everything from understanding core concepts and standards to identifying vulnerabilities and risks within modern networks and infrastructures. Students will gain the expertise to design secure systems, making them resilient against potential attacks. Arden will also teach students the technical skills needed to become an ethical hacker and proactive security tester, as well as how to perform digital forensics and incident management.

Additionally, students will explore cloud, web, and mobile security concepts, becoming adept at recognising critical threats. Arden University emphasises hands-on learning, allowing students to apply essential security techniques to test and protect against real-world attacks and recommend improvements.
8vir:
The demand for qualified data scientists far exceeds the current supply, and the industry faces a significant global skills gap. The MSc Data Science programme is designed to bridge this gap by providing students with the relevant practical skills and expertise needed to excel in data-related roles, giving students a pathway to establishing a fulfilling and potentially lucrative career.

Arden's data science degree covers everything from fundamental mathematical concepts to advanced topics like artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, and cloud computing. Students will master essential tools and programming languages such as Python, in addition to gaining proficiency in software tools like Jupyter Notebooks and Tableau.

Students will also tackle real-world scenarios through their programme's individual modules. Whether students are exploring the ethical and legal constraints of data science or delving into the intricacies of machine learning and deep learning, they will be immersed in practical applications. Arden's "Learn by Doing" philosophy ensures students can apply their knowledge to make meaningful business decisions using real data sets.

Ultimately, students will gain genuine insight into how data science operates, from data gathering and processing to analysis for operational and strategic purposes -- developing a strong understanding of the ethical and legal considerations that shape the role of data science professionals.
8vik:
Study master’s in engineering management with Arden and inspire change. Learn how to spearhead innovative projects with the latest leadership and management skills.

Want to scale up managerial know-how and secure a place at the top levels of engineering management? There is currently a huge demand across industries for professionals with engineering management expertise. Arden's CMI-accredited MSc Engineering Management degree examines the most vital and contemporary areas in the field, all while helping students develop the leadership skills today’s employers are looking for.

The course provides an entry route into engineering management across all engineering disciplines. It is suitable for managers without an engineering background as well as qualified engineers looking to break into management roles. With a strong focus on how to manage modern engineering projects in a global context, students will cover areas of pan-sector relevance such as agile methodology, supply chain management, Big Data, working in cross-disciplinary teams, stakeholder engagement, and much more.

This course is accredited by the Chartered Management Institute (CMI). That means students will be awarded a Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership and Foundation Chartered Manager status upon graduation, giving them a fast-track route to Chartered Manager status.

Arden University’s MSc International Business Management is tailor-made for future global leaders and managers. This programme is designed to help students master the intricacies of today’s interconnected and digitalised business world. Students will gain critical skills to navigate global markets, understand international trade, manage supply chains, and appreciate cultural differences.

Arden's approach combines both theory and practical application, ensuring that students not only learn the foundational concepts but also have the opportunity to apply them through assessments and learning tools. This blend of knowledge prepares students to tackle contemporary challenges and seize opportunities in a global business environment.

Students will explore a broad range of subjects, including international trade, marketing, team management, project management, business transformation, and innovation. Guided by faculty with hands-on experience in international business, students will refine their leadership style and strategic vision, equipping them to thrive in a dynamic and evolving marketplace.

The program culminates in a transformation project, where students will put their learning into practice by addressing a real-world business challenge. This comprehensive experience prepares students to excel as a leader.
8viu:
Designed for anyone who wants to fast-track their career in this sector, the MSc Project Management course enables students to take on greater challenges in project management and increase their competitive edge in the eyes of employers.

On the course, students will develop strategic project management skills that are highly sought after in sectors across all areas of international business – from project analytics and data handling to managing teams and understanding Big Data. The syllabus has been designed to reflect upon and consider contemporary project management practice and the challenges facing the global business environment right now, as well as providing the strategic leadership and management skills that every business needs. To support career development, this course is accredited by the Chartered Association of Project Management (APM), and is the only project management master’s degree in the UK offering a Chartered Management Institute (CMI) Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Management and Leadership*.

With this in mind, the master’s in project management will bring students up-to-speed with the latest project management practices, trends, and developments. As an example, the recent coronavirus pandemic has demonstrated the importance of project management in finding solutions to unprecedented challenges. In fact, project management skills are vital in fields including engineering, technology, education, healthcare, events management, as well as tourism and many more creative and service fields. Because of this, this degree qualification will have wide reaching employer-appeal and is the ticket to a highly rewarding career.
8vin:
Arden's new MBA course has been specifically developed to provide students with a gateway to management and leadership roles. Whether someone already has management experience, or preparing for their first role in business, this MBA qualification will provide them with the skills and competence they need to excel in their career.

The ideal option if students are fresh out of their undergraduate degree or have limited work experience, this course gives students the unique opportunity to use their MBA qualification as a gateway into a managerial role. Students will develop in-depth industry knowledge of contemporary business operations and the ability to apply emerging trends and innovations to leverage strategic business transformations. Through its focus on the most up-to-date, practice-based learning, the course will help students gain the specialised skills required to start a successful career in today’s dynamic business environment.

Students will also be introduced to state-of-the-art virtual business simulations, helping them in responding to the many opportunities and challenges they might face in their future management role. By placing professional development at its core, students will graduate from the MBA with the workplace readiness to enter the business world with confidence.

That means that by the end of the course, students will have developed the real-world skills needed to lead and manage in today’s agile working environment. This, combined with the knowledge of how to drive positive business change will give students a powerful, modern skillset sought after by leading employers in a range of exciting industries.
8vio:
The driving force behind Arden University’s Executive MBA is to help experienced managers disrupt conventional ways of thinking to lead business transformations. The programme equips students with the key skills needed for modern global business management, helping them gain a competitive edge in the industry. Rooted in a learning-by-doing methodology, the degree emphasises directly applying what students learn to their day-to-day role, allowing them to demonstrate immediate impact in their organisation. This, combined with Arden’s flexible learning, means this degree will complement students' careers, not get in the way of it.

With industries transforming faster than ever, organisations will require jobholders to be agile and tech-savvy. That’s why Arden has ensured this Executive MBA takes a digital-first, global, and contemporary approach to learning, ensuring students gain the modern strategic, financial, and people skills they need to meet the current and future demands of a constantly evolving sector. Arden's esteemed lecturers bring a wealth of experience from senior roles in both the private and public sectors, along with significant academic expertise. They have designed the course in consultation with leading UK employers and Arden's international alumni, so students can be confident their studies will provide them with the advanced skill set to become a future leader of tomorrow.

This course has dual accreditation from the Chartered Management Institute (CMI) and the Institute of Leadership and Management (ILM), providing students with the prestigious CMI Level 7 Diploma in Strategic Leadership and Management and ILM Level 7 Diploma in Leadership and Management. That means students will graduate with professional recognition and a qualification that’s recognised across the globe. And with the CMI Level 7 Diploma, students will be eligible for the fast-track route to Chartered Manager status.

The course is ideal for experienced managers who are looking to take their careers to the next level. Arden also offers MBA pathways focused on finance and artificial intelligence, as well as a specialised MBA to help those without work experience break into the world of business management.
